notes: Fix: Hinglish freezing on computers whose NVIDIA graphics card is missing its CUDA libraries ("cublas64_12.dll is not found"). The card was used anyway, the first speech model failed over to the processor, and the Hinglish model then froze. The app now checks for those libraries before it uses the card: if they are missing it uses the processor from the start (slower, but it finishes), and after any graphics-card failure it never tries the card again until the app is restarted.
Fix: the system check now notices a graphics card whose CUDA libraries are missing (it used to say "GPU ready") and offers "Install the GPU libraries".

New: every problem the Deep check finds has a Fix button, plus "Fix everything found" (graphics-card libraries, component repair, speech model download, Hinglish model rebuild). Run the Deep check again afterwards to confirm.
